TAL_SOUND_RESONANT_NOTE.label: Resonant Note
TAL_SOUND_RESONANT_NOTE.why: 'Target: One creature or object you can perceive ... If the target is an unattended object, brittle structure, ordinary barrier, or construct, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage': aimed at a placed object it rolls its Sound Cultivation Attack against the object's AC and deals its damage, plus the Proficiency Bonus for an unattended object, a structure that is fragile (a brittle structure) or a barrier (combat/ext/objects.py add_pb_for_groups). The construct half of the printed list is a creature kind, so the typed damage row carries the same bonus through its own bonus_if_kind (combat/ext/creature_kinds.py).
